integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic dark-fantasy, a low medium-wide shot frames an old monastery interior in moody torchlight, cold stone tones with warm firelight accents. Enormous monstrous claws punch violently through the brick wall from the other side, masonry exploding outward in a spray of dust and rubble. Through the widening breach, a warrior in heavy battle-worn plate armor advances with his shield raised high, pushing through the scattering debris as sparks and dust swirl around him. The camera rushes rapidly forward low to the ground, skimming over broken bricks toward the warrior. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a big close-up of the shield taking a brutal impact — the metal shudders, dust and fragments burst off its surface, and the warrior's gauntleted arm strains under the blow.

overall_soundscape: Brick shatters with deep cracking booms as claws grind against stone, followed by the heavy clank of plate armor and the scrape of tumbling rubble. A thunderous metallic impact rings out on the shield, dust hissing as debris bursts off its surface.

non_diegetic_music: Low, aggressive orchestral percussion with tense string stabs building fast, cutting off sharply after the shield impact.
